Complete Guide

How BloomDay works

Plan your day, earn seeds, tend your garden and keep a journal. Every system, rule and reward in the app, in one place.

Tasks Seeds Plants Garden Focus Mode Challenges Achievements Tokens Journal Time Capsule Bloom Board Growth Journey Moods & Widgets Notion Plans Tips
01 · Tasks

The root of everything

Every seed you earn, every plant you buy and every streak you build starts with finishing a task.

1

Add a task

Type it in, or tap the microphone and say it. BloomDay listens with your phone’s own speech recognition and picks up dates and times from the sentence, in English, Turkish and Spanish. Give it a category: Work, Health, Home, Learn, Social or Self.

2

Set a time window

Give the task a start time and a duration. Finish it inside that window and you earn a bonus seed.

3

Add a reminder

Choose how many minutes before the task the notification should arrive.

4

Add a note

Attach a short note for context. It appears in italics under the task title.

5

Complete it

Tap the circle to finish the task and earn 2 seeds. Swipe left to postpone or delete.

The calendar scrolls 180 days back and 365 days ahead. Tap any day to see its tasks or plan ahead. Finish every task of the day and BloomDay marks the moment with a short closing note. If you add fifteen or more tasks in one day, a mascot checks in to ask how you are feeling.
02 · Seeds & Economy

The currency of your garden

Seeds come from steady work and go to plants and decor. They are meant to feel earned.

ActionSeedsNotes
Complete a task+2Base rate. Once per task per day.
Complete within the time window+1Bonus on top of the base 2.
Complete during Focus Mode+1Stacks with the time window bonus.
Daily Challenge+3 to +10One challenge a day. The reward depends on the challenge.
Focus session completed+3When the timer runs to the end.
Achievement unlocked+5Per achievement.
Plant reaches full bloom+20Comes with a resilience token.
Plant collection completedVariesPlus a badge and a decor item.
Plant trivia quizVariesAnswer questions about your plants.
Seeds never expire. Some rare Eden plants cost 300 to 400 seeds and the largest trees cost 500, so saving for them takes days of steady work. That tension is on purpose.
03 · Plants

Species, growth & full bloom

More than 200 hand-illustrated species across three environments. Plants grow through watering, so finishing tasks buys them and watering raises them.

Watering moods

Thriving

Watered today

Happy

1 day missed

Thirsty

2 days missed

Wilting

3 days missed

Critical

4+ days missed

Plants in BloomDay never die. Even a critical plant recovers as soon as you water it again. Free accounts get a daily watering budget, and paid plans water without limits.

Plant tiers

Free

Starter species such as monstera, snake plant, barrel cactus and pothos.

Bloom

Premium cultivars including calathea, rubber plant, peace lily and orchids.

Forest & Eden

Rare specimens, dwarf fruit trees, heritage vegetables and giant trees.

Every plant comes with real botanical trivia in English, Turkish and Spanish. Seasonal plants appear for a limited time, and themed Collections add more species as one-time purchases.
04 · Garden

Three worlds, 19 themes

Your garden reflects the work behind it. Arrange plants, add decor and switch between themes.

Interior

Cosy Cottage, Zen Studio, Nordic Loft, Grand Manor, Moroccan Terrace, Mediterranean, Attic Hideaway.

Garden

English Garden, Japanese Garden, Tropical Garden, Winter Garden, Treehouse, Picnic Lawn.

Allotment

Allotment, Greenhouse, Rooftop Farm, Night Garden, Village House, Tuscan Vineyard.

1

Switch environments

Interior for houseplants, Garden for outdoor flowers and trees, Allotment for vegetables and herbs. Each has its own catalog.

2

Choose a theme

Cosy Cottage, English Garden and Allotment are free. The rest open with Bloom, Forest or Eden.

3

Buy from the nursery

Tap a plant to see its cost, tier, latin name and trivia, then spend seeds to add it.

4

Arrange your space

Drag plants and more than 100 decor pieces wherever you like, resize them, and long-press to remove.

5

Share your garden

Capture your garden with your stats and share the image anywhere.

05 · Focus Mode

A quiet room for deep work

A full-screen timer with ambient sound, a breathing plant and a small reward at the end.

Choose 25, 45, 60 or 90 minutes. A breathing plant animation keeps you grounded.

Pick one of 18 ambient sounds: lofi, rain, birds, piano, tabla, downbeat, cumbia, afrobeat, vinyl, a purring cat and more.

Tasks you finish during a session earn a bonus seed, and a completed session earns +3. Ending early skips the reward.

If you try to leave, BloomDay asks first. Cancel takes you back to the timer.

25:00

07 · Achievements

Milestones that celebrate you

58 badges in all: 48 achievements across six categories and 10 plant collections. Each achievement adds +5 seeds the moment it unlocks.

TasksStreaksGardenWateringSeedsSpecialCollections
Achievements cover moments like your first task, a 30-day streak, ten plants collected or your first focus session. Collections ask you to grow a themed group of plants, and completing one gives you seeds, a badge and a decor piece for your garden.
08 · Resilience Tokens

Earned, never bought

Resilience tokens are the rarest thing in BloomDay. Money cannot buy them. You can hold up to 10 at a time.

MilestoneTokens
7-day streak+1
14-day streak+1
30-day streak+1
100-day streak+1
A plant reaches full bloom+1
When a streak breaks, BloomDay offers to restore it with one token. Plants do not need tokens, because a little water is always enough to bring them back.
09 · Journal New

Pages you decorate yourself

Your garden has a notebook. Write about your day on a blank page or a template, then decorate it with clay stickers, washi tape and marker text.

1

Start a page

Pick a blank page or a ready-made daily, weekly, monthly or habit template. Tap the question of the day to open a page with that question as its title.

2

Write

Add titles, notes and stamp-style text. Speak instead of typing if you like. Link the page to a plant and choose your paper.

3

Decorate

More than 250 clay stickers in 18 sets: washi tapes, day and month headers, dates, numbers, speech bubbles, weather, critters, treats, tabs, habits and doodles. Stamps and badges unlock as you grow, and today’s mood mascot is always there to stick on the page.

4

Keep and share

Saved pages open again in the same editor for changes. Pin favourites to your Bloom Board, or export pages as a PDF.

Free accounts can keep 3 journal pages and use 15 stickers. Bloom, Forest and Eden open more sticker sets and unlimited pages. The Journal Kit is a one-time purchase that unlocks every sticker for good. Ready-made template sets stay with the plans.
10 · Time Capsule

Letters to your future self

Choose a plant and write a letter to the person you will be when it blooms.

Time Capsule

Sealed until full bloom

The capsule stays closed while the plant grows. When it reaches full bloom, the letter opens on its own.

Patience

Nothing can rush it

A capsule cannot be bought, skipped or opened early. Seal one for a slow-growing plant and you will have forgotten what you wrote by the time it blooms.

11 · Bloom Board New

Pin the life you’re building

A vision board made of clay pins: goals, places, routines and small comforts. Arrange them on the board, then share it as an image.

Free accounts get a real board with a starter set of pins, one for each everyday theme. Plans unlock the full collection. Your board can also live on your home screen as a widget.

14 · Notion & Recurring Tasks New

Bring your own system

BloomDay connects to Notion. Choose one task database and your Notion tasks appear in BloomDay. Finish one here and it is checked off in Notion too, while your garden grows from it.

1

Connect Notion

Open Settings, find Notion under Integrations, sign in and choose the database to sync.

2

Work in either place

Completions flow both ways. You can disconnect at any time from the same screen.

3

Set a repeat

Once, Daily, Weekdays, Weekly, Every 2 weeks, Monthly, or exact dates you pick on a calendar. Each day tracks its own completion.

4

Stop repeating

Swipe left on a recurring task and tap Stop. It becomes a one-time task and its reminder is cancelled.

16 · Tips

Getting the most from your garden

Practical advice for building habits and growing your garden at a pace you can keep.

Water every day

Growth comes from watering. Open the app, water a plant, and let the rest follow.

Use Focus Mode for the hard ones

Tasks finished during a session earn a bonus seed, and the session itself adds three more.

Save for rare plants

Forest and Eden plants cost hundreds of seeds. Saving for them should feel earned.

Guard your streak

One finished task keeps a streak alive. On slow days, do the smallest one.

Speak your tasks

Say “call mum tomorrow at 6” and BloomDay fills in the day and the time for you.

Close the day on paper

A short journal page at night is enough. A sticker and three lines still count.

Every reward should be a consequence of real work, not a shortcut around it. Growth is quiet. It happens one task, one day, one leaf at a time.
